kernel: Native Java port of proxy-agent-core.js ConnectomeSelector
bindings: engineered UI recovery/action bindings, not biological meaning
signs: CPF model hypotheses: serotonin .28, acetylcholine +1, gaba -1, Dh44/Lk and dARC/Ilp .18
learning: autonomy-core.js defaults: successes >=2, reliability >=.66, average reward >=.05; reward .2 only after a known nonterminal result with two independent anchors and two fresh frames
original_fly_circuit: assets/circuit.bin kept unchanged; separate prior olfactory subgraph
limitations: Not a full fly brain, OCR, general-purpose language model or proof of fly-specific superiority; unlabeled canvas actions require demonstrations or recording review

recording_repair.loop: decode locally, compare current graph, preserve old states/IDs, compile incremental proposal, validate on same recording, apply after operation review, reanalyse latest graph or next recording
recording_repair.landmarks: reviewed input region plus up to 3 or more stable anchors; frame-source signatures shared per state
recording_repair.geometry: per-region windowLocal metadata for mixed preset/recording graphs; independent landmark alignment before point/path use
recording_repair.end_of_video: continued observation, never implicit terminal/daily completion
recording_repair.halted_recording: one-state video diagnoses stable/unknown display without inventing an operation
recording_repair.unchanged_result: same registered state or background animation earns no success credit
recording_repair.limits: unknown taps/swipes require review; actual Android picker/MediaMetadataRetriever/gestures not tested on device
